subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should optional `outputSchema` become the supported public plugin contract for structured `AgentToolResult.details` consumed by Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well-proven, but it creates a long-lived external plugin API whose compatibility and error-envelope semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the canonical contract
options.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the single result-schema declaration after preserving framework error envelopes, removing the changelog edit, and refreshing exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep schemas internal initially
options.body: Limit declared result schemas to built-in tools until the external plugin contract and upgrade semantics are designed separately.

options.title: Defer output contracts
options.body: Retain unknown-output and raw-first behavior if maintainers do not want to sponsor a public result-schema API yet.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical contract
recommendation.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the single result-schema declaration after preserving framework error envelopes, removing the changelog edit, and refreshing exact-head proof.
